`docs/mandates.md` opened with "A design note, not yet built", while four B2 actions run through the gateway and the B1 reads run on the systems. A reader who checks one kind against the code then has reason to doubt the rest of the document.

- The status paragraph now names what runs: the B1 reads under one kind per system (`stocklist.read`, `stocklist.photos_read`, `observatory.read`, `glk.read`), checked by the system itself, and the four B2 actions the gateway judges (`stocklist.photos_repair`, `studio.research_draft`, `observatory.trend_edit`, `observatory.trend_site`). It also names what does not run: the finer B1 reads in the tables, the other B2 commands, B3 with `once`, and `bounds`. There is no `once` or `bounds` field anywhere in the Go code.
- The resource example said `gentells:observatory`. The code and Portal use `observatory:pipeline`.

Docs only, no code change.
